created_at.description: The date and time the customer was created.

updated_at.description: The date and time the customer was last updated.

payment_methods.description:
Saved payment methods associated with this customer. Each entry represents a
payment method authorised for future charges. Two types are supported: `card`
(with full card details) and `revolut_pay` (covers both card-backed and
account-to-account Revolut Pay variants). Use the `type` field on each item
to identify the variant.

Billing-Address.title: Billing address
Billing-Address.description: The billing address associated with the payment method.

street_line_2.description: Secondary address line, such as floor and apartment number.

region.description: State or province of the address.

Card-Bin.description: The BIN (Bank Identification Number) of the payment card, typically the first 6-8 digits.

Card-Brand-v2.description: The brand of the payment card.

Card-Expiry-Month.description: The expiry month of the payment card.

Card-Expiry-Year.description: The expiry year of the payment card.

Card-Funding-v2.description: The funding type of the payment card.

Card-Issuer.description: The name of the card-issuing bank or institution.

Card-Issuer-Country.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the country where the payment card was issued.

Card-Last-Four.description: The last four digits of the payment card number.

Card-v2.title: Card payment method
Card-v2.description:
A saved card payment method.

:::info
The `checks` object (3DS, CVV, address verification) is not included as it is specific to the transactional payment context.
:::

Cardholder-Name.description: The name of the cardholder as it appears on the card.

Email.description: The email address of the customer.

Full-Name.description: The full name of the customer.

Payment-Method-Created-At.description: The date and time the payment method was added.

Payment-Method-Id.description: Unique identifier for the payment method.

Payment-Method-Type-v2.description: The type of the payment method.

Payment-Method-v4.title: Payment method
Payment-Method-v4.description:
A saved payment method on a customer profile.

Use the `type` field to determine the specific payment method variant.

:::note
This schema represents a stored credential available for future charges and supports three types: `card`, `revolut_pay`, and `sepa_direct_debit`.

It differs from the `payment_method` object on a Payment, which is a transactional snapshot of how a specific charge was executed and includes additional detail such as wallet wrappers (`apple_pay`, `google_pay`) and Revolut Pay funding source (`revolut_pay_card` vs `revolut_pay_account`).
:::

Phone.description: The phone number of the customer in [E.164 format](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/E.164).

Revolut-Pay-v2.title: Revolut Pay payment method
Revolut-Pay-v2.description:
A saved Revolut Pay payment method on a customer profile.

Both Revolut Pay card-backed and account-to-account (A2A) variants are
represented by this single type at the saved payment method level.
No underlying card details are exposed here; use the order-level
`payments[].payment_method` object (types `revolut_pay_card` /
`revolut_pay_account`) for per-transaction details.

Saved-For.description:
Indicates in which case this saved payment method can be used for payments.

| Value | Description |
| ----- | ----------- |
| `customer` | This payment method can be used only when the customer is on the checkout page. |
| `merchant` | This payment method can be used without the customer being on the checkout page, and the merchant can initiate transactions, for example, to take payments for recurring transactions. |

Sepa-Direct-Debit-Debtor-Iban-Last-Four.description: The last four digits of the debtor's IBAN.

Sepa-Direct-Debit-Debtor-Name.description: The full name of the debtor as provided in the mandate.

Sepa-Direct-Debit-Mandate-Reference.description: The unique mandate reference generated by Revolut. Include this in pre-debit notifications sent to your customers.

Sepa-Direct-Debit-v2.title: SEPA Direct Debit payment method
Sepa-Direct-Debit-v2.description:
A saved SEPA Direct Debit payment method on a customer profile.

:::info
For more information, see: [SEPA Direct Debit server-to-server integration](https://developer.revolut.com/docs/guides/merchant/accept-payments/payment-methods/sepa-direct-debit/server-to-server)
:::

Terminal-Hardware-Id.description:
The hardware identifier of the Revolut Terminal device used to process the payment.

:::note
Only present for card-present transactions processed via Revolut Terminal.
:::
